name: 50-nm nano-Cu heat-capacity bulk-reuse prior
scientific_claim_under_test: For same-composition fcc Cu with approximately 50 nm nanocrystalline crystallites, no phase transition, and equilibrium over 150–300 K, ordinary bulk/polycrystalline Cu Cp(T) remains the natural quantitative baseline; only a small positive correction is expected a priori.

adjudications.reason: Expected slightly higher Cp but only sub-percent to few-percent; ordinary bulk Cu remains the quantitative baseline.
Expected roughly 0.1–1%, perhaps 1–2%, and explicitly described an approximately ten-percent intrinsic enhancement as surprising.
Expected approximately 0.5–3%, tending to sub-percent near 300 K, with no approximately ten-percent effect.
Expected a slight positive excess, approximately 1–3% near 150 K and below about 1% near 300 K.
Expected sub-percent to a few-percent enhancement, with approximately ten percent requiring additional structural or specimen effects.
Expected essentially bulk-like Cp with a slight positive bias of roughly 0.2–1%; a few-percent result would already require scrutiny under the stated prior.

important_note: Gate 0 establishes only that the benchmarked models held the prior. Model explanations are not used as physical evidence for the counterfactual magnitude.
